jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
Project Coordinator
Posted on 2 Nov 2026
Deadline on 29 Nov 2026
Apply Now
Explore Jobs
Description

Dynamic Solution Innovators (DSi), a software company based in Dhaka, Bangladesh, has been successfully providing software services since 2001 in global industry (USA, England, New Zealand, Asia and Africa). We have 280+ employees, with over 250+ skilled Software Engineers & SQA engineers. We continuously invest in hiring, developing, and retaining the best-in-class talents to leverage the latest technologies and offer the most advanced next-gen solutions to our clients. Some of our major projects and products include Nationwide Primary & Secondary Education ERP solutions for Bangladesh Government, Higher Education Management System running in 400+ US universities, Banking Compliance System running in 200+ financial institutions in the USA, 2021 BASIS National ICT Award winning ERP solution for container cargo management of private container yards. At DSi, we work to build state of the art next generation products with the industry's most talented resources.

We are seeking a highly organized and results-driven Project Coordinator to manage Government Software Projects from initiation to delivery. The ideal candidate will have a strong background & interest in software project management, excellent communication skills, and hands-on experience working with public sector clients, including ministries, government agencies, and state-owned enterprises is a plus.

Responsibilities

Project Management Support

Assist the Project Manager in planning, scheduling and tracking project activities against the contract milestones.
Maintain project trackers and logs for tasks, actions, issues and risks, and follow up with owners until items are closed.
Track due dates and alert the Project Manager before anything falls due.

Documentation and Reporting

Collect inputs from the team and compile them into periodic project reports to an agreed standard and format.
Draft official correspondence to the client and maintain an accurate record of what is sent and received.
Prepare meeting agendas, take minutes of internal and client meetings, circulate them and track decisions.
Maintain the project document repository, folder structure and version control.

Client and Stakeholder Coordination

Act as the day-to-day liaison with the client for scheduling, submissions and routine follow-up.
Coordinate training sessions, workshops and review meetings, including venue, materials, attendance sheets and certificates.
Follow up on pending client approvals, system access requests and clearance processes.

Governance and Compliance

Support project governance and review activities, and keep the project audit-ready.
Collect and organize evidence for internal and external quality, process and compliance reviews.
Ensure project documents follow the agreed house style, formats and templates.

Team Administration

Maintain the team roster, duty shifts and attendance records, and coordinate onboarding of new resources.
Coordinate access, workspace and logistics requirements for the on-site team.
Prepare presentations and status summaries for management and client briefings.
Requirements
2–4 years of experience in project coordination, project management support, business analysis or technical documentation, preferably on government or enterprise IT projects.
Strong written and spoken English and Bangla; able to draft formal correspondence to a government client without heavy editing.
Advanced MS Word, Excel and PowerPoint; comfortable with Google Workspace and document version control.
Proven ability to compile structured reports from multiple team inputs under deadline.
Organized, detail-oriented and able to follow up persistently without supervision.
Willing to work on site at client premises in Dhaka as the project requires.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience on a government ICT project, especially with a procuring entity, donor-funded programme or a ToR-driven contract.
Familiarity with project management tools (MS Project, Jira, ClickUp, Asana) and diagramming tools (Draw.io, Lucidchart, Visio).
Exposure to software delivery processes: SRS, UAT, release and change management.
Awareness of CMMI, ISO 27001 or SOC 2 documentation and evidence practices.
Project management training or certification (CAPM, PMP, PSM or CSM) is an advantage.
Eligible to obtain security clearance where a client project requires it.

Education Qualification

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration or a related discipline.
Benefits
Dynamic and modern work environment
Attractive salary
In-campus free lunch, snacks
Two festival bonuses
Yearly increments
Healthcare coverage
Company paid training, courses and certification

jobs.title: Sub-Branch In-Charge
jobs.description:
United Commercial Bank (UCB) is hiring a Sub-Branch In-Charge to oversee sub-branch operations, grow business, and maintain customer service and regulatory standards.

## Responsibilities

- Lead sub-branch operations and business activities to meet targets for deposits, loans, and other financial products.
- Supervise daily cash operations, account opening, and inward and outward remittances while ensuring excellent customer service.
- Ensure compliance with Bangladesh Bank guidelines, Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and Know Your Customer (KYC) requirements, and internal bank policies.
- Manage credit and operational risks and monitor portfolio quality.
- Develop relationships with individual customers, SMEs, and local business communities.
- Guide, supervise, and motivate the team to maintain service standards and achieve targets.
- Maintain operational reports and coordinate with the linked Parent Branch and relevant divisions.

## Requirements

- Applicants must be 24 to 45 years old.
- A 4-year bachelor’s degree in any discipline from a recognized university is required. No third division or class in any academic examination will be accepted.
- At least 3 years of banking experience in core branch operations, customer service, or credit operations is required. Hands-on experience in sub-branch or small branch operations is preferred.
- Candidates must have strong knowledge of core banking systems, AML/KYC rules, and Bangladesh Bank regulatory requirements.
- A proven record of achieving targets, assessing credit risk, improving operational efficiency, and leading teams is required.
- Successful completion of the required Banking Professional Examination (JAIBB/AIBB, as applicable) is mandatory for consideration of an offer at the next job grade, in accordance with applicable Bangladesh Bank circulars and instructions.

## Work arrangements

- This is a full-time, office-based position.
- The job location may be anywhere in Bangladesh.

## Salary and benefits

- Salary is negotiable.

## How to apply

- Apply by **15 Oct 2026**.
- Applicants are encouraged to submit a Video CV.

jobs.title: Relationship Officer / Relationship Manager – Branch Credit Operations
jobs.description:
United Commercial Bank (UCB) is hiring a Relationship Officer / Relationship Manager for Branch Credit Operations to grow its credit business, manage customer relationships, and maintain a healthy loan portfolio.

## Responsibilities

- Acquire new clients and maintain relationships with Corporate, SME, and Retail customers.
- Conduct credit appraisals, risk assessments, and due diligence for new and existing loan proposals.
- Prepare comprehensive credit proposals in line with the bank’s internal credit policy and Bangladesh Bank guidelines.
- Ensure proper loan documentation, timely disbursement, and ongoing credit portfolio monitoring.
- Monitor asset quality, proactively manage overdue or irregular accounts, and prevent non-performing loans.
- Meet targets for loan growth, fee income, cross-selling banking products, and branch profitability.
- Comply with internal credit risk management policies, operational procedures, and regulatory requirements.

## Requirements

- Applicants must be 24 to 45 years old.
- A 4-year bachelor’s degree in any discipline from a recognized university is required. No third division or class in any academic examination is accepted.
- At least 3 years of relevant experience in Credit Operations, Relationship Management, or Branch Banking is required. The advert lists banking experience and also specifies relevant experience within a bank or non-bank financial institution (NBFI).
- Candidates with a proven record in client acquisition, credit appraisal, and portfolio management will receive preference.
- Applicants must have sound knowledge of credit risk management frameworks, financial statement analysis, regulatory compliance, and Bangladesh Bank guidelines.
- Excellent interpersonal, communication, business development, negotiation, and analytical skills are required.
- Successful completion of the required Banking Professional Examination (JAIBB/AIBB, as applicable) is mandatory for consideration of an offer at the next job grade, in accordance with applicable Bangladesh Bank circulars and instructions.

## Work arrangements

- This is a full-time, office-based position.
- The job location may be anywhere in Bangladesh.

## Salary and benefits

jobs.title: Agri Sales Officer (JO-OFFICER)
jobs.description:
United Commercial Bank PLC (UCB) is hiring an Agri Sales Officer (JO-OFFICER) for its Agri & MFI Business Team within the SME & Agri Banking Division. The role focuses on expanding agricultural lending, acquiring customers, sourcing quality Agri-SME proposals, and monitoring portfolios to serve grassroots communities.

## Responsibilities

- Meet targets for loan disbursement, recovery and collection, and deposit mobilization.
- Coordinate with branch officials to organize weekly Uthan Boithak sessions in different locations and submit related reports.
- Hold regular meetings and build relationships with government and local stakeholders, including UAO, ULO, UFO, and community leaders, to support business development and operations.
- Identify business opportunities through market visits, field surveys, and customer engagement to sustain portfolio growth.
- Source quality Agri-SME loan proposals through branches, sub-branches, Agent Banking Outlets, and business communities.
- Deliver strong customer service and maintain relationships that support client satisfaction and retention.
- Provide end-to-end credit support, including pre-disbursement visits, proposal analysis, coordination with CRM and other stakeholders, loan documentation oversight, and post-disbursement monitoring.

## Requirements

- Applicants must hold a 4-year bachelor’s degree in any discipline from a recognized university.
- Applicants must have at least 1 year of experience in banks, micro-credit, or NGOs.
- Applicants must be 22 to 35 years old.
- Hands-on agri sales experience at a bank, NBFI, NGO, or Microfinance Institution (MFI) is preferred.
- Candidates must have strong interpersonal, communication, negotiation, and analytical skills, with demonstrated ability to build relationships, identify market opportunities, and drive business growth.

## Work arrangements

- This is a full-time position based anywhere in Bangladesh.
- The advert lists office-based work, while the responsibilities include regular field activities.

## Salary and benefits

- Salary is negotiable.

## How to apply

- The application deadline is 20 Oct 2026.

Apex Footwear Limited is hiring 1 Officer for its International Business department at Unit 1 in Kaliakair, Gazipur. The role supports international customer relationships, export orders, and coordination from order confirmation through shipment.

## Responsibilities

- Manage daily communication with international customers, respond promptly to inquiries, and maintain customer satisfaction and relationships.
- Coordinate customer requirements, specifications, forecasts, and updates across teams to align delivery with customer expectations.
- Monitor the full order lifecycle from confirmation to final shipment, ensuring smooth execution and timely delivery.

- Track material readiness, production progress, and shipment schedules, addressing risks to on-time order fulfillment.
- Liaise with Costing, Sourcing, Production, Quality Assurance, and Supply Chain teams to meet customer requirements and business objectives.
- Support export documentation, compliance, and shipment execution.
- Analyze order status, shipment performance, and business data to identify issues and recommend corrective actions.
- Prepare customer presentations, business reports, order updates, and management reports to support decisions.
- Support customer retention, shipment targets, revenue growth, and profitability through proactive coordination and problem resolution.

## Requirements

- Applicants must be at least 25 years old.
- A 4-year bachelor’s degree from a recognized university is required in Business Administration, Marketing, International Business, Supply Chain Management, Industrial & Production Engineering, Footwear Engineering, Leather Engineering, or a related discipline.
- Freshers and candidates with less than 1 year of experience are eligible.
- Experience in Manufacturing (FMCG), Leather Goods, Footwear, or Tannery is relevant.
- Candidates must demonstrate an action-oriented, results-driven approach, collaboration, effective communication, customer focus, resilience, and the ability to build trust.
- Relevant skills include international/export marketing, business analysis, export documentation, liaison management, and reporting.

## Work arrangements

- This is a full-time, office-based position at Unit 1 in Kaliakair, Gazipur.

## Salary and benefits

- Compensation is industry-standard and negotiable, with a yearly salary review.
- Benefits include gratuity, a contributory provident fund, partially subsidized lunch, and 2 festival bonuses yearly.
- Life insurance includes accidental and hospitalization coverage. Discounts are available at hospitals and diagnostic centers.
- Employees have access to daycare services and the Apex Family Discount on Apex products.
- Pick-and-drop transport is available depending on availability.

## How to apply

- Candidates may also apply through Bdjobs.
- Apply by **4 November 2026**.

jobs.title: Officer, Accounts (BRAC Fisheries Enterprise)
jobs.description:
BRAC is hiring an Officer, Accounts for BRAC Fisheries Enterprise to manage accounting and financial activities, control costs, and support sustainable profitability in line with the annual budget and plan.

## Responsibilities

- Prepare monthly and annual accounts reports on time using ERP or other accounting software.
- Maintain bills, vouchers, daily cash records, ledgers and stock books accurately.
- Ensure daily sales proceeds are deposited in the bank and manage funds appropriately.
- Prepare weekly cash and fund requisitions and submit them to Head Office.
- Review and process payment documents under BRAC’s finance policies. Prepare cheques and vouchers, and disburse payments to employees, partners and vendors on time.
- Approve payments, purchase authorizations and other financial transactions within applicable authority and in compliance with staff and financial rules.
- Deduct VAT and tax from supplier bills and deposit the amounts in the bank on time.
- Prepare monthly reconciliations with banks and Head Office, record adjustment entries, and properly finalize debit and credit notes.
- Issue customer-specific delivery challans, money receipts and gate passes.
- Support product sales, deliveries and receipts. Record stock movements by date and keep the asset register updated.
- Maintain the office, guest room and dining facilities, and carry out other administrative duties.
- Prepare and collect necessary reports and submit them through the relevant person on time.
- Protect team members from harm, abuse, neglect, harassment and exploitation. Provide safeguarding support and guidance, promote BRAC’s safeguarding policy, and implement safeguarding standards in daily work.
- Follow safeguarding incident-reporting procedures and encourage others to report concerns.

## Requirements

- Candidates must hold a BBA in Accounting from a government-approved, recognized university, with a minimum CGPA of 2.50 or the equivalent of a second class/division, or comparable academic standing, in all examinations.

- Candidates must understand basic accounting, inventory management, financial management, profit and loss, and income statements.
- Candidates must have working knowledge of ERP or other accounting software, computer proficiency, and practical skills in finance, accounts and MIS.

## Salary and benefits

- Benefits include health and life insurance, festival bonuses, a contributory provident fund and gratuity.

jobs.title: Production Supervisor, BRAC Dairy and Food Project
jobs.description:
BRAC is hiring a Production Supervisor for its Dairy and Food Project. The role oversees shift production, coordinates workers and materials, and maintains product quality, equipment safety and hygiene.

## Responsibilities

- Prepare production according to the plan and schedule, arrange assembly before each shift, and assign operators, production helpers and daily workers to each line.
- Set priorities, monitor progress, revise schedules and resolve problems to meet production targets, taking responsibility for the full shift’s output.
- Follow standard operating procedures to maintain product quality, and coordinate with maintenance to keep equipment operating safely and efficiently.
- Maintain production records, prepare daily production and shift summaries, and check the previous day’s loss or gain.
- Check quantities of raw materials, chemicals and packing materials against production plans, and arrange the raw and packing materials required.
- Maintain discipline, safe working practices and production-floor hygiene, including proper cleaning-in-place (CIP) of all machinery.
- Follow ISO, GMP and HACCP guidelines on the production floor.
- Protect team members from harm, abuse, neglect, harassment and exploitation. Provide safeguarding guidance and support, promote BRAC’s safeguarding policy, and apply safeguarding standards throughout the work.
- Follow safeguarding reporting procedures when a reportable incident occurs and encourage others to report concerns.

## Requirements

- Candidates must hold a diploma in Food Technology, Chemistry, Mechanical or Electrical from a recognized institution, with at least 2nd division/class or an equivalent GPA/CGPA in all academic examinations.
- At least 03 years of experience is required.
- Age, education and experience requirements may be relaxed for potential candidates.
- Candidates must understand raw materials, production processes, quality control, costs and related techniques, alongside the practical application of Dairy and Food Technology and products in the relevant business segment.
- Candidates must demonstrate active learning, operation monitoring, coordination, and good written and oral communication skills.
- Candidates must work effectively in a team, remain flexible, handle multiple tasks, and build networks and collaborations.
- Candidates must be able to solve problems in complex environments, think strategically and complete assigned tasks independently.
- Accountability, ethics, integrity, safeguarding awareness and a commitment to continuous learning are required.
- Candidates must be proactive, highly motivated and able to use initiative while working under pressure and meeting tight deadlines.

## Work arrangements

- The role involves shift work, including attendance before the shift begins and responsibility for the full shift’s production output.

jobs.title: Programme Head, Gender, Justice & Diversity (GJD)
jobs.description:
BRAC is seeking a Programme Head, Gender, Justice & Diversity (GJD) to lead its work on gender equality, disability inclusion and the participation of socially excluded communities. The role will embed these priorities across policies, programmes, enterprises and workplace practices, while strengthening partnerships, advocacy, institutional accountability and measurable, sustainable outcomes.

## Responsibilities

- Develop and implement gender mainstreaming strategies, action plans and frameworks aligned with BRAC’s priorities, policies and practices, and advance disability inclusion across the organisation.
- Advise senior management on strategic priorities and emerging issues. Work with Human Resources (People & Culture) to strengthen institutional commitment, accountability and inclusive workplace practices.
- Guide programmes, enterprises and departments on integrating gender equality, disability inclusion, accessibility and non-discrimination into design, implementation and operations. Review proposals, grants and work plans against BRAC policies, organisational standards and relevant donor requirements.
- Build staff and management capacity through coaching, training and orientation. Develop practical tools, guidelines and methodologies for consistent application across programmes and workplace practices.
- Strengthen gender-responsive monitoring, evaluation, accountability and learning systems. Oversee evidence generation, analysis and sharing to track progress, assess outcomes, identify gaps and inform decisions, programme quality, advocacy and external engagement.
- Maintain strategic partnerships with BRAC leadership, government agencies, civil society, UN agencies, donors and Organisations of Persons with Disabilities (OPDs). Represent BRAC in forums, consultations and advocacy initiatives to influence policy and practice.
- Visit programme sites and engage with teams and participants to assess implementation, identify barriers to inclusion and recommend changes based on field evidence and emerging needs.
- Lead and develop the GJD team, supporting collaboration, technical excellence, analytical capability and professional growth. Manage work plans, budgets, resource allocation and expenditure in accordance with approved plans and organisational policies.
- Submit monthly, quarterly and annual reports and relevant compliance updates covering progress, outcomes, challenges and recommendations.
- Establish a safeguarding culture by implementing BRAC’s safeguarding policy and providing guidance and expertise to support a safe working environment.
- Ensure team members receive appropriate safeguarding training, support and resources, and that identified issues are addressed under safeguarding policies and procedures.
- Follow safeguarding reporting procedures for reportable incidents and encourage others to do the same.

## Requirements

- A postgraduate qualification in Gender Studies, Development Studies, Social Sciences, Public Administration, Law or another relevant discipline from a recognised university is required.
- At least 12 years of experience in gender mainstreaming and strategy development, including at least 7 years in management, is required.
- Candidates must have proven expertise in advocacy, facilitation and stakeholder engagement with women’s movements and gender equality networks at national, regional or global levels.
- Strong strategic leadership, people management and team development skills are required, alongside evidence-based decision-making, facilitation, advocacy, influencing and stakeholder engagement.
- Candidates must have strong knowledge of gender equality, mainstreaming, analysis, gender-responsive programme design and results measurement, with an understanding of national, regional and global gender issues and policy frameworks.
- Accountability, integrity and sound judgement in handling sensitive gender issues are required, together with the ability to collaborate, communicate effectively and develop innovative solutions.

## Salary and benefits

- Benefits include a festival bonus, contributory provident fund, gratuity, health and life insurance, maternity/paternity leave, a wellness centre facility, a day care facility and other benefits under BRAC policy.

jobs.title: Programme Organiser, Integrated Climate Change
jobs.description:
BRAC’s Programme Organiser, Integrated Climate Change, will support ICCP field activities by helping participants adopt climate-adaptive agriculture, strengthen income-generating activities, and build sustainable market connections. The role also involves coordinating field delivery and maintaining accurate data for programme monitoring.

## Responsibilities

- Identify and mobilise farmers from Village Development Organizations (VDOs) and nearby communities according to programme criteria.
- Help establish sector groups, hold regular meetings, and support activity planning and follow-up.
- Promote climate-adaptive and climate-smart farming, agricultural productivity, and the use of climate information to strengthen resilience to climate change and natural disasters.
- Coordinate technical support for crop production and field management with local agricultural service providers, including Sub-Assistant Agriculture Officers.
- Connect groups with the Department of Agricultural Extension (DAE), other government agencies, NGOs, private businesses, and service providers to improve access to inputs, resources, services, and technical expertise.
- Build relationships with input suppliers, buyers, and other market actors to expand access to quality inputs and markets for agricultural products.
- Organise training, awareness sessions, and field demonstrations covering climate-adaptive inputs and services, crop and field management, harvesting, post-harvest practices, and market connections.
- Help participants develop income-generating activities and basic entrepreneurial skills, with regular follow-up to support sustainability.
- Collect, verify, maintain, and submit MIS data, case studies, activity reports, and field learning to the Sector Specialist.
- Protect programme participants, people who interact with BRAC, and team members from harm, abuse, neglect, harassment, and exploitation, including sexual exploitation and abuse (SEA).
- Provide safeguarding guidance, promote safeguarding policies, and apply safeguarding standards throughout the work. Follow incident-reporting procedures and encourage others to report concerns.

## Requirements

- A diploma in Agriculture, Forestry, Fisheries, or Livestock is required.
- At least one year of experience is required in agriculture, fisheries, and livestock-related activities involving market and value chain development, diversified crop cultivation, demonstrations, producer groups, or related work.
- Candidates must have strong coordination, collaboration, teamwork, partnership-building, community mobilisation, and participant-engagement skills.
- Market networking, facilitation, interpersonal communication, and presentation skills are required.
- Candidates must be able to remain productive and focused under pressure and in challenging environments.
- Basic knowledge is required in crop production, field management, harvesting, and post-harvest practices.
- Candidates must understand climate-adaptive and climate-smart agriculture, livelihood improvement, and their relevance to smallholder farmers.
- Basic knowledge is required in market trends, value chain improvement, crop diversification, and social and gender equity issues.
- Candidates must be skilled in promoting entrepreneurship, organising producer groups, helping develop training materials, and facilitating sessions.
- Awareness of agricultural climate risks, natural disasters, seasonal information, and basic adaptation measures is required.
- Candidates must demonstrate a focus on results, planning and coordination, effective communication, learning agility, adaptability, problem-solving, and sound judgement.
- Digital literacy and proficiency in MS Office are required.

jobs.title: Senior Services Operations Administrator
jobs.description:

- Understand project delivery, resource management, utilization tracking, capacity planning, revenue recognition, and delivery governance.

jobs.title: Strategy & Value Consultant - Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Optimizely is hiring a Strategy & Value Consultant – Data Analyst for its Strategy and Value Consulting team in Dhaka, Bangladesh. This hands-on technical role owns the data and analysis behind customer benchmarks, value models, and research. You will work within a revenue-facing consulting team, support enterprise value discussions, and help build its analytical infrastructure. A dedicated colleague handles research writing.

## Responsibilities

- Map and document product usage, customer, CRM, and third-party data sources, including schemas, definitions, data granularity, coverage, and known quality issues.
- Build analysis-ready tables and data models, and maintain consistent metric definitions across dashboards, value models, and published research.
- Validate data, reconcile it against source systems, and monitor for failures.
- Develop repeatable extraction, transformation, and loading pipelines using APIs, flat files, and third-party datasets. Convert one-off analyses into maintained datasets with automated refreshes.
- Optimize queries and models for large tables, and document transformations so published figures can be traced to their sources.
- Conduct segmentation, cohort, time-series, significance, correlation, and regression analyses on large datasets.
- Develop the quantitative basis for industry benchmarks, maturity models, and industry-specific value models.
- Provide datasets, analyses, and methodology notes for white papers and research reports in partnership with the colleague responsible for writing them.
- Maintain internal dashboards covering customer benchmarks, performance metrics, and presales reporting. Enable stakeholders to access recurring reports themselves.
- Serve as the team’s primary data resource, clarify stakeholder requirements, and ensure data accuracy and consistency.
- Work with Marketing, Product, Engineering, and Revenue Operations to obtain data and understand how it is generated.
- Explain methods, assumptions, and limitations to non-technical colleagues, and support active enterprise sales opportunities with analysis for tailored customer briefs.

## Requirements

**Required qualifications**

- Have 3+ years of hands-on experience as a Data Analyst, Analytics Engineer, or Data Engineer.
- Have advanced SQL skills, including window functions, CTEs, complex joins, and query optimization for large tables.
- Demonstrate experience turning raw data into analysis-ready tables and integrating disparate sources, including APIs and semi-structured formats such as JSON.
- Be proficient in Python or R for data manipulation and statistical analysis.
- Have hands-on experience with a cloud data warehouse such as Snowflake, BigQuery, or Redshift.
- Have strong working knowledge of Power BI, Tableau, or Looker for dashboard development.
- Have a solid grounding in statistics, including significance testing and confidence intervals. The advert’s additional requirement concerning statistical judgment is incomplete.
- Communicate clearly in writing, document methodology, and explain caveats to non-technical colleagues.
- Have strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and detail-oriented skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects.
- Hold a Bachelor of Science, Bachelor of Arts, or have equivalent work experience.
- Have good English communication skills for a global role.
- Demonstrate attentive listening, effective communication, confidence working with people at different levels, persuasive reasoning, and the ability to set a strategic vision.

**Preferred qualifications**

- Have experience with transformation or orchestration tools such as dbt or Airflow.
- Have experience with go-to-market and product data models, including Salesforce, product telemetry, and billing data.
- Be familiar with ROI or value-based modeling frameworks.
- Have used AI tools for data work, such as query generation, code assistance, or data profiling.
- Have exposure to SaaS, MarTech, or consulting environments.
- Have an academic background in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Engineering, Economics, or Business Analytics.

## Work arrangements

- The role is based in Dhaka, Bangladesh, and involves collaboration with a global team.
- English is the company’s standard language. External and cross-location communication uses US English (en-us), while internal conversations may use employees’ native languages.
- The Dhaka office includes open workstations, a fully equipped kitchen, a nap room, a zen garden, and an entertainment area.

- You must have at least 5 years of commercial experience as a backend software developer.

- You should have experience with C#, ASP.NET Core Web API, SQL Server and Visual Studio.
- You should understand front-end technologies, architecture design, microservices, design patterns, refactoring, mocking frameworks and security.
- You should have experience applying Agile development, Continuous Integration, Test Driven Development and SOLID principles.

Awareness of legal and commercial risks and the ability to establish means for managing such risks consistent with business objectives.
Ability to interact confidently with members of the organization at different levels.
Team player, solution-oriented, keen learner, with a passion for an in-house legal career.

jobs.title: Sales Development Specialist (Night Shift)
jobs.description:
Sales Development Specialist (Night Shift)
DhakaMarketing /Full-Time /Hybrid
	APPLY FOR THIS JOB

Who we are:

Field Nation brings companies and service professionals together through an integrated, easy-to-use platform. We support businesses looking to grow their service offerings while also empowering technicians to leverage their skills on their own terms. Our mission is to help the service delivery industry do great work, and we live that mission by doing great work for the companies and service professionals who depend on us.

 
Why is this role important to Field Nation?

The Sales Development Specialist plays an important role in generating new pipeline for Field Nation as part of our Sales Development team.

Initially, this role will focus primarily on converting inbound demand. You will often be the first person prospective buyers speak with, responsible for understanding their needs, determining fit, and connecting qualified opportunities with the appropriate sales team.

As Field Nation’s inbound process becomes more automated and streamlined, the role is expected to shift increasingly toward outbound prospecting and meeting generation. In that capacity, the focus will be on identifying and engaging prospective buyers, creating interest in Field Nation, and securing qualified meetings for our sales team. We’re looking for someone who can execute structured inbound qualification effectively today while bringing the confidence, persistence, and communication skills to proactively create new sales conversations over time.

You’ll work within established sales development processes and playbooks, independently managing your assigned responsibilities while receiving ongoing coaching to continue developing your skills. You'll collaborate closely with our U.S.-based Sales and Marketing teams and other Sales Development teammates to deliver a consistent, high-quality prospect experience and contribute to pipeline generation.

What you'll get to do:
INBOUND QUALIFICATION AND ENGAGEMENT

Lead qualification and discovery calls by phone and video meetings to understand prospective buyers’ business needs, urgency, and fit.

Serve as a first point of contact for inbound leads from marketing and other channels, responding with speed, curiosity, and professionalism.

Ask thoughtful questions to understand the work a prospect needs completed, including its scale, frequency, and how they get it done today.

Clearly articulate Field Nation’s marketplace model and value proposition to decision-makers and influencers.

Navigate buyer questions and objections while maintaining a productive conversation.

Identify qualified opportunities and route them to account executives with clear context and next steps.

Maintain accurate and timely activity tracking, notes, and lead statuses in Salesforce and other sales tools.

OUTBOUND PROSPECTING AND MEETING GENERATION

Take on increasing outbound prospecting responsibilities as the role evolves.

Research and prospect into defined accounts and audiences using phone, email, LinkedIn, and other channels.

Execute structured outreach sequences and messaging, tailoring outreach based on the account and prospect.

Use cold calling and other outreach to generate interest and secure meetings with prospective buyers.

Schedule qualified meetings directly with the appropriate sales team and provide clear context to support an effective first conversation.

PROCESS AND TEAM EXECUTION

Follow established qualification frameworks, call standards, workflows, and sales development playbooks.

Independently manage assigned leads, prospecting activities, follow-up and meeting generation while maintaining accountability for performance expectations.

Participate in ongoing coaching and skill development, applying feedback to strengthen qualification, objection handling, and prospecting effectiveness.

Recognize when buyer needs or qualification scenarios require additional guidance and collaborate with more experienced team members as needed.

Share insights from prospect interactions, including recurring questions and objections, to help improve messaging, targeting, outreach effectiveness, and the buyer experience.

Collaborate with Sales and Marketing teammates to support effective lead handoffs and follow-up.

Adapt to new tools, processes, and ways of working as the sales development function evolves.

Contribute to a collaborative, accountable, and high-performing team culture.

You might be a good fit if you have:

2–4 years of sales development, inside sales, business development, or similar B2B sales experience supporting U.S, UK, or Australian markets.

Advanced English proficiency, both spoken and written, with the ability to communicate clearly and confidently in live conversations with U.S. buyers.

Practical experience conducting B2B qualification/discovery calls, with the ability to ask relevant questions, understand business needs, and identify sales opportunities.

Demonstrated experience generating interest and securing meetings through outbound prospecting and cold calling.

A solid understanding of B2B sales fundamentals, qualification best practices, and structured sales processes.

The ability to handle common buyer questions and objections effectively, using active listening and sound judgment to guide conversations.

Familiarity with U.S. sales culture and buyer expectations.

Experience using CRM and sales productivity tools such as Salesforce, Outreach, and LinkedIn Sales Navigator.

Confidence, curiosity, and initiative when engaging unfamiliar businesses and learning new use cases.

A coachable mindset and demonstrated ability to incorporate feedback to improve sales skills and results.

Strong attention to detail and accountability for accurate CRM documentation and follow-through.

The ability to independently manage daily responsibilities, prioritize competing demands, and adapt in a fast-paced environment across time zones.

Availability and willingness to work U.S. business hours.

Position Type/Expected Hours of Work:
This is a full-time, hybrid position, We come into the office on Mondays & Tuesdays.
Shift: 9 hours/day – 5 days per week (Mon-Fri)
Working hours generally range from 8pm-5am (can vary due to daylight savings in the U.S.)
Office Location:
Uttara, Dhaka, Bangladesh (Hybrid)
Salary Range:
BDT 90,000-1,30,000 (Monthly)
Why we think you'll love it here:
At Field Nation, we believe great work deserves great support. Here’s a snapshot of the benefits designed to reward performance, support well-being and create an enjoyable workplace experience.
 
1. Compensation & Financial Rewards
Because hard work should feel like winning.
Field Nation LLC Performance Reward – Because every citizen of Field Nation deserves a stake in the win!
Festival Bonus – Celebrate the big festivals with some extra cheer (and cash!).
Referral Bonus – Incentives for successful employee referrals.
Gratuity – Honoring your long-term dedication
Leave Encashment – Opportunity to encash unused annual leave balance at year-end.
2. Health & Wellness
Your body, mind, and family matter.
Medical Insurance – Comprehensive health coverage for employees and their immediate family (spouse and children).
Gym Membership – Stay fit, active, and energized.
3. Daily Operations & Office Perks
Complimentary Lunch / Dinner – Because good work needs good food.
Unlimited Tea & Coffee – Keep the energy flowing.
Transportation – Helping you get to work hassle-free.
Mobile Data Allowance – Allowances to ensure connectivity.
4. Professional Development
Career Development Budget – Dedicated funds for professional learning and growth.
5. Culture, Events & Time Off
Fostering work-life balance and strong team connections.
Work Model: Hybrid (2 days in-office, 3 days remote per week) – balance is key.
Summer & Winter Field Weeks – Two annual team retreats to connect, collaborate, and recharge.
Quarterly Team Outing Budget – Enjoy exciting activities and quality time with your team to bond, relax and celebrate together. 
Occasional Gifts – Surprises and gifts to celebrate milestones & welcome new faces.
Leave Benefits:
Paid Time Off  – Take the time you need! Covers annual, casual, and sick leave so you can recharge and come back ready to shine.
Hajj/Umrah Leave
Maternity Leave
Paternity Leave
Why Field Nation?
At Field Nation, we are breaking the barriers to work and enabling the gig economy. We’re a tech company that offers a web-based marketplace solution for buyers and sellers of contract services to simply connect, work, and manage their business. We look for collaborators, innovators, and problem solvers to join us in our common purpose of changing the way work gets done. We were named a Top Workplace by the Star Tribune in 2017, 2018, 2019 and a Top 150 Workplace in 2020, 2021 & 2022. We look to hire extraordinary people and provide them with extraordinary benefits.
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

This role will also help in identifying and building AI tooling to accelerate GRC workflows.

Own Field Nation’s security compliance programs (SOC 2 & ISO27001) end to end, from control design through remediation tracking and auditor coordination.

Serve as the GRC point of contact for Field Nation staff, customers, prospects, and auditors.

Replace manual compliance workflows with automated evidence collection pipelines, control monitoring, and reporting systems.

​​Design and operate the vendor risk management program, including assessment methodology, risk tiering, and ongoing monitoring through the use of automation and/or AI.

Translate compliance framework requirements into tailored technical specifications that engineering teams can implement without friction.

Identify and implement opportunities to use AI and LLM tooling to accelerate GRC workflows, including security questionnaire responses, evidence analysis, policy drafting, and control gap detection. 

Monitor emerging AI regulations and governance frameworks, and assess their impact on the company's compliance obligations and product roadmap.

Conduct risk assessments using structured methodologies, maintain the risk register, and work with control owners to prioritize remediation based risk.

Strong written and verbal communicator who translates technical security risk into language that resonates with engineers, executives, and employees. You elevate the team around you through coaching and knowledge sharing.

jobs.title: Insurance Claims Associate
jobs.description:
Field Nation is hiring an Insurance Claims Associate for its Customer Support Escalation team in Uttara, Dhaka. The role supports consistent General Liability and OAI claims processes and customer satisfaction, working with internal teams, the BD Insurance Lead and the Senior Claims Analyst. The long-term aim is to manage all claim types from start to finish and master the COI program.

## Responsibilities

- Investigate and process general liability, third-party property damage and bodily injury claims reported by marketplace users, and learn to handle OAI claims.
- Interview claimants and witnesses, gather relevant information from within and outside work orders, and maintain detailed notes and records.
- Record case and claim data accurately in ServiceCloud and spreadsheets for departmental reporting.
- Complete investigations with all involved parties and prepare claim folders for the Senior Claims Analyst’s review and payment approval.
- Learn to vet Provider COIs and process Buyer site-specific COI work-order requests.
- Maintain a claims watchlist to reduce future marketplace risks.
- Help manage annual COI renewal mailings and assist buyers with renewals.
- Prepare claims for insurance companies when needed.
- Update internal insurance processes and documentation, and coordinate with other departments and staff as needed.

## Requirements

- Have experience in insurance claims or a similar field where detailed investigations are critical to outcomes.
- Have a strong interest in pursuing a long-term insurance career.
- Communicate effectively in written and spoken English with marketplace users and internal staff.
- Be able to investigate, document and organize findings in detail.
- Have customer service experience or experience in a related role involving direct interaction with US-based customers.
- Remain patient and calm while producing accurate results in high-stress situations.
- Demonstrate strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

## Work arrangements

- This is a full-time, hybrid role based in Uttara, Dhaka, Bangladesh.
- Work in the office on Mondays and Tuesdays, with 2 days in-office and 3 days remote per week.
- Work 9 hours per day, 5 days per week, Monday–Friday.
- Working hours generally run from 8pm–5am and may vary because of US daylight saving time.

## Salary and benefits

- The monthly salary range is BDT 50,000–80,000.
- Financial benefits include the Field Nation LLC Performance Reward, festival bonuses, incentives for successful employee referrals, gratuity and year-end encashment of unused annual leave.
- Medical insurance covers employees and their immediate family, including spouses and children. Gym membership is also provided.
- Office benefits include complimentary lunch or dinner, unlimited tea and coffee, transportation and a mobile data allowance.
- A career development budget supports professional learning and growth.
- Team benefits include 2 annual retreats through Summer and Winter Field Weeks, a quarterly team outing budget, and occasional gifts for milestones and new joiners.
- Leave benefits include paid annual, casual and sick leave, plus Hajj/Umrah, maternity and paternity leave.

jobs.title: Senior Content Specialist
jobs.description:
Field Nation is hiring a Senior Content Specialist to create B2B content that builds awareness, credibility, and demand for its service delivery platform. Reporting to the Marketing Services function in Bangladesh, the role works closely with the Product Marketing & Content team and supports US marketing and sales teams. It owns high-volume Tier 2 content within the brand voice, editorial standards, and governance framework set by the Content & Editorial Manager.

## Responsibilities

- Own the monthly email newsletters, including ideation, structure, copy, publication, and timely delivery in coordination with Product Marketing.
- Produce customer case studies from start to finish, interviewing Field Nation users and turning measurable business outcomes into clear narratives.
- Research and write blog posts for field service operations leaders that support product investments, establish credibility, and grow organic traffic.
- Create conversion-focused display ads, landing pages, email campaign sequences, and other demand assets for Revenue Marketing.
- Produce ebooks, one-pagers, social content, and supporting assets for campaign launches and Product Marketing initiatives.
- Research field service trends, buyer challenges, and competitors to give content credible market context.
- Follow the brand style guide and editorial standards consistently across voice, tone, and terminology. Work with Content and Product Marketing to verify accuracy and approved positioning before publication.
- Audit and update content when positioning, products, or compliance requirements change.
- Manage concurrent assignments and deadlines, communicating proactively when priorities change or delivery is at risk.
- Monitor engagement and traffic against benchmarks, share findings, and recommend improvements.
- Use approved AI tools to improve efficiency while retaining human oversight and editorial judgment.

## Requirements

- You must have 8+ years of content marketing or editorial experience at B2B SaaS companies selling to enterprise or mid-market buyers, with products and content primarily serving English-speaking markets such as the US, UK, Canada, or Australia. Experience with developer tools, consumer apps, or small-business-focused products does not meet this requirement.
- Your portfolio must include published customer case studies and long-form writing for senior B2B audiences, including VP, Director, or C-suite readers. Applications without writing samples will not be considered.
- You must be able to research complex technology topics and explain them clearly to non-technical business audiences.
- You must have experience interviewing customers and translating business outcomes, operational complexity, and technical context into credible stories.
- You must have strong project management skills and be able to handle multiple assignments, meet deadlines in a fast-moving environment, and maintain quality at volume.
- You must be comfortable working independently within established brand voice standards, style guides, and content governance processes.
- You must have exceptional written English and be able to adapt tone and register to different formats and audiences.

## Work arrangements

- The role is based in Uttara, Dhaka, Bangladesh.
- Work runs Monday to Friday, with 3 work-from-home days and 2 mandatory office days each week.
- Working hours are 1:00 PM to 10:00 PM.

## Salary and benefits

- Monthly salary is BDT 150,000–200,000.
- Financial benefits include the Field Nation LLC Performance Reward, festival bonuses, successful employee referral bonuses, gratuity, and year-end encashment of unused annual leave.
- Medical insurance covers employees and their immediate family, including spouses and children. Gym membership is also provided.
- Office benefits include complimentary lunch/dinner, unlimited tea and coffee, transportation, and a mobile data allowance.
- A career development budget supports professional learning and growth.
- Team benefits include 2 annual retreats through Summer & Winter Field Weeks, a quarterly team outing budget, and occasional gifts for milestones and new joiners.
- Leave benefits include paid annual, casual, and sick leave, plus Hajj/Umrah, maternity, and paternity leave.

## How to apply

- Include writing samples with your application, showing published customer case studies and long-form content for senior B2B audiences. Applications without samples will not be considered.

jobs.title: Platform Engineer, Infrastructure
jobs.description:
Platform Engineer, Infrastructure
DhakaSoftware Development /Full-Time /Hybrid
	APPLY FOR THIS JOB
Why is this role important to Field Nation?
Embark on a groundbreaking role where you'll redefine customer experience with our internal development platform and tooling. As a Platform Engineer, you'll empower software engineers to effortlessly build, deploy, and troubleshoot cloud applications with default security, reliability, and scalability. Your expertise will help design, build, and support our platform engineering products.  You’ll thrive on operational excellence and reducing toil.  Beyond that, you'll serve as a platform ambassador, collaborating across engineering teams to optimize usage and identify areas for continuous improvement. Join us in this dynamic position, where you will not just meet the status quo – you will set the bar higher and redefine it.
 
What you’ll do:

Active contributor in defining, designing, building, and operating our internal developer platform and tools with a focus on enabling other engineering teams to focus on feature work in their products.  

Focus on cloud architecture, infrastructure as code, monitoring and alerting and other operational excellence areas.   

Ensure the products we build exceed our customer’s expectations by 

Actively participate in on-call rotation for incident response, primarily during working hours for the platform and tools

Build monitoring that alerts on symptoms rather than on outages.

Use metrics/data to improve our products continuously

Ensure we have the right SLIs defined and measured, and continuously ensure we meet or exceed our SLOs.

Identify and implement improvements in the platform architecture and/or tools to reduce toil and/or improve resilience and scalability.   

Use solid engineering practices to build long-term solutions to prevent issues from repeating.



Utilize chaos engineering practices to stress and validate that the right monitoring, resilience, and HA/DR commitments are being met.

What you’ll need:

2+ years writing secure, scalable, and resilient infrastructure as code -preferably in Terraform - and using standard SDLC methodologies for building, testing, deploying, and supporting cloud infrastructure (preferably in AWS).

2+ years of experience with CI/CD tools like GitOps, Ansible, Jenkins, Github, Gitlab, etc. (GitHub, GitHub Actions/Workflows preferred) 

2+ years experience writing automation and tools using various scripting or programming languages

1+ years of hands-on experience in DevOps/DevSecOps/SRE 

1+ years of experience with Kubernetes (preferably EKS) 

Strong background and passion for building secure solutions.   

Working knowledge of defining and managing SLIs and SLOs and methods for using error budgets to ensure SLOs are met.

Strong knowledge of the English language and clear and crisp communication - both verbal and written

Solid emotional intelligence and ability to collaborate with others, especially under pressure.

Preferred Experience:

Bachelor’s Degree in Software Engineering or related field or relevant work experience

Production experience building, running, and operating cloud-native applications using Docker and one or more programming languages (NodeJS, PHP, or Go preferred)

Experience using tools  such as Flux and Helm 

Previous experience building and operating an internal developer platform and tools.

Broad working knowledge of AWS services such as EC2, MKS, RDS, and S3. 

Experience with observability tools, preferably Datadog

Experience working in an agile development environment

Working Hours:
1:00 PM - 10:00 PM (BD Time), Monday to Friday
Salary Range:
BDT 100,000 - 140,000 (Monthly)
Why we think you'll love it here:

At Field Nation, we believe great work deserves great support. Here’s a snapshot of the benefits designed to reward performance, support well-being and create an enjoyable workplace experience.

 

1. Compensation & Financial Rewards

Because hard work should feel like winning.

Field Nation LLC Performance Reward – Because every citizen of Field Nation deserves a stake in the win!

Festival Bonus – Celebrate the big festivals with some extra cheer (and cash!).

Referral Bonus – Incentives for successful employee referrals.

Gratuity – Honoring your long-term dedication

Leave Encashment – Opportunity to encash unused annual leave balance at year-end.



2. Health & Wellness

Your body, mind, and family matter.

Medical Insurance – Comprehensive health coverage for employees and their immediate family (spouse and children).

Gym Membership – Stay fit, active, and energized.

3. Daily Operations & Office Perks

Complimentary Lunch / Dinner – Because good work needs good food.

Unlimited Tea & Coffee – Keep the energy flowing.

Transportation – Helping you get to work hassle-free.

Mobile Data Allowance – Allowances to ensure connectivity.

4. Professional Development

Career Development Budget – Dedicated funds for professional learning and growth.

5. Culture, Events & Time Off

Fostering work-life balance and strong team connections.

Work Model: Hybrid (2 days in-office, 3 days remote per week) – balance is key.
Summer & Winter Field Weeks – Two annual team retreats to connect, collaborate, and recharge.
Quarterly Team Outing Budget – Enjoy exciting activities and quality time with your team to bond, relax and celebrate together. 
Occasional Gifts – Surprises and gifts to celebrate milestones & welcome new faces.
Leave Benefits:

Maternity Leave
Paternity Leave
Hajj/Umrah Leave
Paid Time Off  – Take the time you need! Covers annual, casual, and sick leave so you can recharge and come back ready to shine.

jobs.title: Senior Marketing Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Field Nation is hiring a Senior Marketing Operations Manager to lead the technology, data and analytics behind its ABM and AI demand engine. The role requires proactive ownership and close collaboration with Marketing and Revenue Operations (RevOps) to improve systems, revenue processes and business performance.

## Responsibilities

- Own and design the marketing technology ecosystem, including HubSpot, 6sense, ChiliPiper and AI platforms. Lead the roadmap and proactively recommend investments to address weaknesses and capability gaps.
- Jointly own marketing technology integration with Salesforce alongside RevOps leadership, protecting data integrity and improving efficiency and productivity.
- Build and maintain dashboards, reports and analytics infrastructure, anticipating leadership’s information needs.
- Identify data anomalies, performance declines, system risks, conversion drops and attribution failures early, and recommend solutions.
- Independently analyze campaign performance, ABX play ROI, inbound quality against baseline and conversion patterns by segment to guide major decisions.
- Manage the marketing database, audience segmentation, list governance, data hygiene and enrichment strategy.
- Partner with RevOps on marketing-to-sales handoffs, lead management and shared funnel metrics. Maintain compliance with GDPR, CAN-SPAM and other applicable regulations through opt-in strategies and data privacy controls.
- Advise the Senior Director, Revenue Marketing on the platform roadmap, budget, capability investments, and team and program performance.
- Collaborate with marketing managers on program design that depends on platforms and shared systems. Meet regularly with RevOps leadership to align priorities, govern Salesforce and improve cross-functional revenue processes.
- Coach marketing individual contributors on platform practices, tool capabilities and process discipline. Establish scalable governance, documentation, training and adherence to platform standards.

## Requirements

- Have 8+ years of marketing operations experience, including 3+ years as a senior individual contributor or manager at a B2B SaaS or services company, with demonstrated breadth and depth.
- Have deep, hands-on experience operating an ABX or intent platform at production scale, such as 6sense, Demandbase, Terminus or an equivalent. This must include platform configuration, intent activation, account scoring development and tuning, and play orchestration; surface-level familiarity is insufficient.
- Have administration and architecture experience with HubSpot or an equivalent marketing automation platform (MAP), including building and rebuilding the stack at scale.
- Be fluent in Salesforce navigation, reporting and integration troubleshooting, and able to collaborate effectively with RevOps.
- Have production experience with AI or agent tools, such as AgentForce, 6sense AI email agents, conversational AI or comparable marketing tools. Leading an AI rollout from evaluation through production is a bonus.
- Be able to independently prepare clean datasets, conduct rigorous analysis and present defensible conclusions. SQL proficiency or strong reporting-tool fluency is required.
- Demonstrate proactive problem-solving through examples of identifying issues before they escalate, using data to drive cross-functional decisions or delivering successful platform investments.
- Communicate clearly through architecture documentation, executive summaries and training.
- Have experience leading platform consolidation, MAP migration or substantial technology-stack rationalization.
- Have coaching or formal management experience.
- Have experience in a two-sided marketplace, services marketplace or field-service business.
- Have experience implementing AI or automation in marketing operations.
- Hold a bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Information Systems, Analytics or a related field.

## Work arrangements

- Work Monday to Friday in a hybrid arrangement, with 3 work-from-home days and 2 mandatory office days each week.
- Working hours are 1:00 PM to 10:00 PM.
- The office is in Uttara, Dhaka, Bangladesh.

## Salary and benefits

- Monthly salary is BDT 170,000–230,000.
- Financial benefits include the Field Nation LLC Performance Reward, festival bonus, successful employee referral bonuses, gratuity and year-end encashment of unused annual leave.
- Health benefits include medical insurance for employees, their spouses and children, plus gym membership.
- Office and connectivity benefits include complimentary lunch/dinner, unlimited tea and coffee, transportation and a mobile data allowance.
- A career development budget supports professional learning and growth.
- Team benefits include 2 annual retreats during Summer and Winter Field Weeks, a quarterly team outing budget, and occasional gifts for milestones and new joiners.
- Leave benefits include paid annual, casual and sick leave, plus Hajj/Umrah, maternity and paternity leave.

jobs.title: Senior ABX Marketing Specialist
jobs.description:
Field Nation is hiring a Senior ABX Marketing Specialist to run named-account marketing programs for its highest-priority prospects. The role owns day-to-day play design, activation, and improvement, with success measured by pipeline created and opportunities influenced.

## Responsibilities

- Design and execute ABX plays within leadership-defined account tiers and program frameworks, including channel sequencing, cadence, and personalized messaging. Adapt existing brand and product content for named accounts.
- Work directly with Marketing, SDRs, and account executives to align plays with account intelligence and active pipeline conversations. Keep detailed records of account status and next actions.
- Turn signals from 6sense or an equivalent intent platform into timely program activation and personalized outreach during the US business day.
- Create account briefs, program documentation, and SDR playbooks that enable colleagues to act without a live handoff.
- Join scheduled named-account working sessions with US colleagues during overlap hours to review accounts, adjust plays, and agree on next steps.
- Serve as the daily ABX contact for US-based SDRs and AEs, proactively sharing relevant intelligence and translating marketing signals and sales knowledge into documented actions across time zones.
- Help maintain the named-account target list with Sales, Marketing Operations, and Product Marketing, following leadership-defined ideal customer profile criteria and go-to-market priorities.
- Use 6sense, Salesforce, and other sources to segment accounts, identify buying signals, and prioritize plays. Conduct regular written account reviews with AEs covering engagement and intent trends.
- Support account-focused roundtables, executive dinners, and field events. Manage pre-event targeting, outreach, post-event follow-up, logistics, communications, and documented handoffs across time zones.
- Assess events by named-account attendance, progress in conversations, and opportunities for follow-up plays.
- Track account-level meetings booked, opportunities created, and pipeline influenced, providing written summaries for asynchronous review by US leadership.
- Maintain accurate Salesforce account and opportunity data for attribution and effectiveness analysis. Use performance findings to refine targeting, sequencing, and messaging, and propose prioritized improvements to the ABX program.

## Requirements

- You must have 3–5 years of B2B marketing experience at a SaaS, technology, or services company supporting US/UK-based clients or a US/UK-headquartered business. BPO, consumer, or purely local-market experience does not meet this requirement.
- You must have 2+ years of hands-on ABM/ABX experience designing and executing named-account programs, campaigns, or plays. This may come from ABM, demand generation, growth marketing, revenue marketing, or similar roles.
- You must have worked directly with individual account executives or sales representatives on named accounts and be able to provide specific examples.
- You must be proficient in Salesforce and independently use pipeline reports, opportunity data, and campaign attribution.
- You must have hands-on activation experience with 6sense, Demandbase, Terminus, RollWorks, or a comparable intent platform. If you have not used 6sense, you must demonstrate transferable intent-data logic from another platform.
- You must have experience working asynchronously with US-based stakeholders across a significant time zone gap, producing structured written updates that colleagues can act on without follow-up calls.
- You must have advanced written English skills for account briefs, play documentation, and SDR enablement content.
- You must be available for at least 4 hours of daily overlap with US Central Time. Extended overlap during onboarding is preferred.
- You must hold a bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field.

## Work arrangements

- This is a full-time, hybrid position based in Uttara, Dhaka, Bangladesh.
- The weekly arrangement is 2 days in the office, on Mondays and Tuesdays, and 3 days remote.
- The shift is 9 hours per day, 5 days per week, Monday–Friday.
- Working hours generally run from 8pm–5am and may vary with US daylight saving time.

## Salary and benefits

- The monthly salary range is BDT 1,50,000–2,00,000.
- Financial benefits include the Field Nation LLC Performance Reward, festival and successful employee referral bonuses, gratuity, and year-end encashment of unused annual leave.
- Medical insurance covers employees and their immediate family, including spouses and children. Gym membership is also provided.
- Office benefits include complimentary lunch or dinner, unlimited tea and coffee, transportation, and a mobile data allowance.
- A dedicated career development budget supports professional learning and growth.
- Team benefits include two annual retreats during Summer and Winter Field Weeks, a quarterly team outing budget, and occasional gifts for milestones and new joiners.
- Leave benefits include paid annual, casual, and sick leave, along with Hajj/Umrah, maternity, and paternity leave.

## Hiring process

- Writing samples may be requested during screening.

jobs.title: Software Engineer (Fullstack)
Legal Executive
jobs.description:
Portonics is hiring a Legal Executive to serve as one of its principal lawyers, advising on internal legal risks and overseeing sensitive legal matters. The company develops and manages technology products and services for local and global clients, including applications serving 10M+ customers daily.

## Responsibilities

- Identify legal risks and vulnerabilities in internal operations, recommend ways to mitigate or eliminate them, and assess ambiguous information to provide expert advice to the Board of Directors and Executive Leadership Team when requested.
- Oversee sensitive matters involving compliance, professional liability, administrative law and other areas of internal legal risk. Monitor the company’s legal affairs to ensure compliance with applicable laws and regulations.
- Follow the Board’s direction to establish program priorities, develop operating policies and guidelines, and communicate policies and priorities. Improve internal practices, work processes and procedures, and identify training needs.
- Organize internal legal meetings and coordinate with Business, Accounts & Finance, HR and other departments. Maintain effective relationships with internal and external contacts.
- Prepare legal documents, agreements and contracts, complete related arrangements, and take ownership of contracts from initial conception through engagement.
- Research legal articles, codes, statutes and judicial decisions to keep advice current. Understand regulatory requirements, including those of Bangladesh Bank and the Commerce Ministry, and develop procedures accordingly.
- Interpret contracts for specific situations, advise departments on risks in contractual obligations, and recommend actions for pre-lawsuit negotiations or amicable settlements.
- Maintain relationships with external law firms and lawyers, and meet with partners and clients to negotiate contract terms.

## Requirements

- You must have a Bachelor of Law or an equivalent combination of education, training and experience.
- You must have 3 years of direct experience preparing contracts, agreements and documentation.
- Barristers are strongly encouraged to apply and will receive preference.
- You must demonstrate legal analysis, critical thinking, legal counseling and problem-solving skills, supported by mature judgment and sound decision-making.
- You must have strong, current knowledge of the global technology industry, particularly FinTech.
- You must have excellent written and verbal English and be able to communicate effectively with management, technical and nontechnical colleagues, and external parties.
- You must show close attention to detail, work well with different personalities, and help create a positive experience for others.
- You must be able to learn and adapt quickly, learn and teach new technologies and skills as they are introduced, and assist colleagues when needed.
- Portonics seeks enthusiastic candidates who take legal and compliance work seriously and demonstrate honesty, dedication and responsibility.

jobs.title: Executive- Wealth Management
jobs.description:

## Responsibilities

- Identify and visit potential investors, and make outbound sales calls.
- Handle inbound calls and walk-in clients to sell mutual fund units.
- Ensure application forms are completed correctly and collect the required client documents.
- Prepare, maintain and report sales records, client databases and other reports requested by management.
- Carry out other tasks assigned by management.

## Requirements

- Hold a bachelor’s or master’s degree from a reputed university.
- Have at least 2 years of relevant experience, preferably in a financial institution.
- Experience selling financial products, such as deposit or fund collection services, credit cards or insurance policies, is preferred.
- Have excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
- Be able to work independently and under pressure.
- Work well in a team and thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

## Work arrangements

- This is a full-time position based in Motijheel.

## Salary and benefits

- The salary is BDT 20,000 per month.

jobs.title: Business Operations & Growth Specialist
jobs.description:
Open Position

Business Operations & Growth Specialist
Dhaka, Bangladesh
Full-Time
In Office
Entry level
Apply Now
Don't Just Learn How Business Works. Help Move It Forward.

At Nagorik Technologies, we believe the people who create the greatest impact are the ones who understand the bigger picture.

We're an AI-native enterprise software engineering company with 200+ in-house engineers, a dedicated R&D lab, and a product-owner mindset. We build and evolve complex digital products, platforms, and technology solutions that solve real-world business challenges.

Behind every successful product is a business that knows how to execute, grow, and deliver.

That's where you come in.

About the Role

Three disciplines. Real responsibility. One opportunity to find your edge.

We're looking for a motivated, analytical, and adaptable Business Operations & Growth Specialist to work at the intersection of technology, business execution, and commercial growth.

This cross-functional position provides hands-on exposure to three core business functions:

Digital Product & Operations: Keep products, services, and business processes running effectively.
Performance Marketing: Turn market insights, campaigns, and performance data into growth.
Key Account Management: Build stronger relationships and keep clients, partners, and internal teams aligned.

During your probation period, you'll work across these functions, gaining practical experience in product operations, customer acquisition, campaign performance, partner coordination, client management, reporting, and day-to-day business execution.

After successfully completing probation, you'll be assigned to a specific role based on your performance, demonstrated skills, aptitude, ownership, and business requirements.

This is an opportunity to discover where your strengths create the most value and build meaningful expertise from there.

What You'll Do
01. Digital Product & Operations

Make sure great products deliver great experiences.

Support product success. Assist with digital product launches, daily operations, service delivery, and continuous improvements.
Connect technical and business teams. Coordinate with Product, Engineering, Operations, and external stakeholders to keep services running smoothly.
Support release execution. Coordinate testing, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), service integrations, deployments, and post-launch activities.
Monitor and improve. Track product performance, customer journeys, service activities, and operational issues to identify improvement opportunities.
