jobs.title: Tender Documentation Specialist
jobs.description:
Riseup Labs is hiring 1 full-time Tender Documentation Specialist to identify business opportunities and manage accurate, competitive and compliant tender submissions. The role requires 3–5 years of hands-on tender and bid documentation experience and close coordination with technical, finance and management teams.

## Responsibilities

- Review EOIs, RFPs, RFQs and tender opportunities from relevant sources. Prepare bid/no-bid summaries, eligibility and compliance matrices, and submission plans for the Department Lead.
- Prepare complete bids for government, semi-government, autonomous, development, banking and financial, NGO/INGO and private-sector clients. Handle hard-copy submissions, e-GP and procuring entity portals, including UNGM and UNDP Quantum.
- Coordinate technical and financial proposals, concept notes, project proposals, capability statements, key personnel CVs and other pre-sales and project development documents.
- Attend pre-bid meetings, document proceedings, submit clarification requests within the stipulated time, and incorporate addenda and responses into bids.
- Submit bids before deadlines and retain submission evidence. Check formatting, presentation, mandatory forms, declarations, signatures, seals and supporting documents for completeness and compliance.
- Represent the company at technical and financial proposal openings, sign attendance and opening records when required, and report results and competitor quotations to the Department Lead.
- Prepare materials for client meetings, technical presentations and proposal defense sessions.
- Work with banks to arrange, amend and extend tender securities, bank guarantees, performance securities, pay orders, solvency certificates and other required documents.
- Maintain and improve an organized, version-controlled repository of legal and statutory records, experience certificates, completed contracts, audited financial statements, templates and previous bids. Statutory records include trade licenses, TIN, BIN/VAT, incorporation documents and tax return acknowledgements.
- Monitor expiry and renewal dates for statutory documents, registrations and enlistments, and notify the Department Lead well in advance.
- Maintain a tender tracker covering submissions, securities, technical and financial opening results, evaluations and post-submission clarifications.
- Draft joint venture and consortium agreements, letters of intent, powers of attorney, manufacturer and partner authorizations, and other bid correspondence.
- Support departmental documentation, including contracts, negotiation records and periodic reports.

## Requirements

- Applicants must hold a bachelor’s or master’s degree in a relevant field from a reputed public or private university.
- Applicants must have 3–5 years of hands-on experience in tender and bid documentation.
- Sound working knowledge of the Public Procurement Act 2006, Public Procurement Rules 2025 and BPPA Standard Tender/Proposal Documents is required.
- Applicants must be proficient in e-GP tenderer registration and renewal, document preparation, online tender security and online submission.
- Practical experience with UNGM, UNDP Quantum and other procuring entity portals is required, including vendor registration and profile maintenance.
- Applicants must understand procurement guidelines used by development partners such as the World Bank, ADB, JICA, KOICA and UN agencies.
- Experience must include EOIs, technical and financial proposals, RFQs, quotations and framework/LTA bids across the client sectors listed above.
- Applicants must be able to write concept notes, project proposals, capability statements, methodologies and work plans that directly address solicitation evaluation criteria.
- Familiarity with bidding-related bank instruments, their formats and the lead times needed to arrange them is required.
- Strong written English and Bangla are required for formal correspondence, clarification requests, covering letters and declarations.
- Advanced skills in MS Word, MS Excel, MS PowerPoint and Adobe Acrobat are required. Word skills must include styles, tables of contents, cross-referencing and section formatting.
- Proficiency with generative AI tools for drafting, analysis, summarization and document preparation is mandatory.
- Applicants must demonstrate attention to detail, sound judgment on bid responsiveness and compliance, and the ability to manage several submissions under tight deadlines.
- BPPA procurement training (formerly CPTU), e-GP training or a recognized procurement certification is an added advantage.
- Working knowledge of Canva, Adobe InDesign or a similar design tool, and experience building or working with AI agents, are added advantages.
- Candidates with ICT, software, digital content or e-learning tender experience will receive preference.

## Work arrangements

- This is a full-time, onsite role in Uttara, Dhaka.
- Working hours are 9.00 AM to 6.00 PM.
- Employees receive 2 weekly holidays.

## Salary and benefits

Salary is negotiable based on experience and skills. The following benefits apply to Bangladeshi employees:

- Annual performance evaluation and increment.
- 02 festival bonuses, according to company policy.
- Group life and health insurance.
- Fully subsidized lunch/dinner.
- Annual retreats and celebrations of events and occasions.
- Training and development delivered by organization-assigned consultants.
- 24 days of paid time off for casual and sick leave (CL & SL).
- Maternity leave with benefits, paternity leave and bereavement leave, according to company policy.
- Public holidays according to the Riseup Labs calendar.

## Hiring process

1. Telephone round.
2. Interview with the Tender Lead, Operations and Talent Acquisition team.
3. Final interview with the CEO.
4. Job offer.

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted during recruitment.

jobs.title: Senior SecOps Engineer
jobs.description:
SELISE Digital Platforms is hiring a Senior SecOps Engineer in Dhaka to protect its cloud and application environments. The role partners with engineering, DevOps, and infrastructure teams to integrate security into software delivery and day-to-day operations.

## Responsibilities

- Operate and improve security monitoring and threat detection using Microsoft Sentinel, SIEM/SOAR, EDR, CSPM, vulnerability scanners, and related platforms.
- Investigate alerts, suspicious activity, and potential incidents, and lead or support containment, root-cause analysis, remediation, and incident response.
- Maintain Azure security controls covering IAM/RBAC, privileged access, service identities, Key Vault, secrets, networking, and access management.
- Secure AKS/Kubernetes clusters, Docker containers, cloud-native workloads, container images, networking, and secrets.
- Identify and prioritize vulnerabilities, track remediation, strengthen security configurations, respond to CVEs, and manage VAPT activities and penetration-testing remediation.
- Add security controls and automated checks to CI/CD and DevSecOps workflows, and build tools that reduce manual investigation and response work.
- Support Terraform/IaC security, policy-as-code, architecture reviews, and security-by-design across enterprise cloud platforms with multiple environments.
- Embed security requirements, reviews, testing, and risk mitigation throughout the enterprise application development lifecycle.
- Maintain security documentation, procedures, incident records, and audit evidence, and support ISO 27001 and GDPR controls.
- Work with developers, DevOps, architects, infrastructure teams, and management to communicate security risks and remediation priorities.

## Requirements

- You must have 5+ years of experience in Security Operations, Cloud Security, DevSecOps, Infrastructure Security, or a related field.
- You must understand security operations, monitoring, threat detection, incident response, vulnerability management, CVEs, hardening, and remediation.
- You must have hands-on Azure security experience, knowledge of cloud security architecture, and practical experience with Microsoft Sentinel or another SIEM platform.
- You must have strong knowledge of IAM/RBAC, networking, identity, privileged access, secrets management, Key Vault, and access controls.
- You must have experience securing Kubernetes/AKS, Docker containers, cloud-native workloads, and container images.
- You must be able to interpret VAPT and penetration-testing findings and drive practical remediation.
- You must understand DevSecOps, secure SDLC, CI/CD security integration, Terraform/IaC security, and policy-as-code.
- You must have scripting and automation skills in Bash, Python, PowerShell, or similar tools.
- You must understand ISO 27001 and GDPR security controls and be familiar with SIEM/SOAR, EDR, CSPM, vulnerability scanners, and security automation platforms.
- You must take a proactive, security-first approach to identifying and resolving risks, with an emphasis on automation.
- You must have strong analytical, incident-management, communication, documentation, and cross-functional collaboration skills, including the ability to explain incidents, risks, and remediation priorities clearly.
- Relevant cloud or security certifications, such as Azure Security Engineer, Security Operations, or equivalent credentials, are an advantage.

## Work arrangements

- This is a full-time, permanent position based in Dhaka.

## Salary and benefits

- SELISE offers a competitive salary and opportunities for career growth.
- You will work with supportive peers and mentors in a collaborative engineering environment.
- The role offers participation in innovation initiatives, architecture discussions, and technical leadership, with room to experiment and make an impact.
- Learning opportunities include training, knowledge sharing, and hands-on challenges.
- Team-building events and recreational activities are available.

jobs.title: Jr. Executive, Customer Experience
jobs.description:
Shikho, a Bangladeshi education technology company, is hiring Junior Executives for its Customer Experience team. The role combines customer support, relationship management, and sales through upselling and cross-selling.

## Responsibilities

- Build and maintain customer relationships, answer questions, and help customers understand Shikho’s offerings.
- Handle inbound calls, label all queries, and respond promptly to inquiries on social media.
- Resolve customer complaints efficiently and escalate critical issues to a supervisor.
- Identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities, drive business growth, and achieve sales targets.
- Monitor and maintain key performance indicators (KPIs).
- Support customer satisfaction, value, and retention through ongoing relationship management.
- Collect customer feedback, understand customer needs, and share insights with other teams to inform decisions that improve satisfaction.

## Requirements

- Candidates with 3 to 6 months of query-handling experience across inbound calls, outbound calls, and Messenger will receive preference.
- Tele-sales experience is preferred.
- Applicants must have good typing speed in both Bangla and English.
- Applicants must have extensive experience gathering and interpreting customer experience information.
- Applicants must have basic knowledge of online customer engagement platforms and channels.
- Applicants must be proficient in MS Office, Google Docs, and Google Sheets.
- Applicants must demonstrate strong interpersonal skills and a customer-centered approach.
- Applicants must have strong organizational, time management, communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills.
- Applicants must be able to work on a roster basis.

## Work arrangements

- This is a contractual position based in Mirpur 6, Dhaka.
- Working hours are 5 days a week, 9 hours per day, on a roster basis.

## Salary and benefits

- Gross salary is BDT 12,000 to 14,000 per month.
- Additional monthly incentives are based on sales and KPI performance.
- The role offers opportunities for career growth, rapid progression within the organization, and potential permanent employment.
- Shikho describes its working culture as supportive of employee growth.

jobs.description:

The Role:

Shikho is seeking a dedicated and detail-oriented Junior Executive to join our Program Operations team. In this role, you will play a critical part in ensuring the smooth execution of live & recorded classes, including different sessions across our platform. You will coordinate with teachers, manage studio operations, and maintain the systems that keep our classes running on time and at the highest standard. This is an excellent opportunity to build a career in operations within a fast-paced, mission-driven EdTech environment.


Key Responsibilities:

• Prepare and ensure the readiness of the live class studio prior to every session.
• Manage live class operations across multiple platforms, including the Shikho App, Zoom, OBS Studio, Google Meet, and other relevant tools.
• Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues during live classes, coordinating with the product team where required.
• Communicate class schedules with teachers and relevant stakeholders to ensure timely and accurate execution.
• Maintain consistent communication with teachers and arrange replacements promptly in the event of absences to prevent disruption.
• Record and maintain backups of live classes within Shikho's internal systems.
• Update class routines on time and ensure accurate entry of live classes in the application backend.
• Maintain operational tracking systems, including Excel sheets, catalog trackers, and supporting documentation.
• Oversee studio equipment maintenance, inventory management, and ensure all tools remain in optimal working condition.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure synchronized and seamless execution of all live class operations.


Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree from a reputed institution; a background in Computer Science or a related field is preferred.
• Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and Google Workspace (Sheets, Docs, Drive).
• Hands-on experience with, or a strong working knowledge of, OBS Studio, Zoom, or similar live streaming and class delivery tools.
• Foundational understanding of video and audio setup, streaming workflows, and online class delivery systems.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a high attention to detail.
• Proven ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize effectively in a fast-paced environment.
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills in both Bangla and English.
• Strong coordination and teamwork abilities across cross-functional teams.
• Composure and effectiveness under pressure and tight deadlines.
• Willingness to work flexible hours as required to support live class operations.
• High level of ownership, accountability, and reliability.
• Adaptability and a quick-learning mindset for new tools, technologies, and systems.

The Important Bits:

- Job Type: Contractual
- Working Hours: 3:00 PM – 11:00 PM (or equivalent), 5 days a week
- Weekend: 2 days per week (roster-based)
- Location: Shikho Gulshan Campus
- Department: Program Operations
- Reporting To: Deputy Manager
- Gross Salary: BDT 20,000 per month




About Shikho:




Shikho is a Bangladeshi education technology start-up with a mission to democratise access to high-quality education. It has so far raised $8 million USD of international funding from global venture capitalists in Singapore and America, the highest for a Bangladeshi seed-stage startup and the highest in education technology for the country. Investors include education technology investment specialists Learn Capital from Silicon Valley, regional experts Wavemaker Partners from Singapore along with the Family Office of Singtel Chairman and local partner SAJIDA Foundation. Shikho aims to build a holistic learning ecosystem for a digitally enabled Bangladeshi student population, across primary, secondary, and tertiary education.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Backend
jobs.description:
Shikho, a Bangladeshi education technology startup working to widen access to quality education, is hiring a Software Engineer, Backend. The role focuses on building and maintaining scalable microservices, improving platform reliability, and developing AI-powered services using Golang.

## Responsibilities

- Take end-to-end quarterly ownership of assigned microservices within a fleet of 30+ services, including live class, core, gateway, live exam, machinary, kpi, analytics, anubadok, and Shikho AI.
- Design and build scalable, high-throughput Golang microservices with comprehensive test coverage.
- Build and maintain Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) retrieval pipelines, embedding stores, and evaluation datasets for AI-powered services.
- Resolve production issues, investigate root causes, and improve endpoint performance and overall system health.
- Turn product and platform requirements into technical architectures and contribute to technical design discussions.
- Represent the backend platform in REST/GraphQL API design and collaborate with Mobile and Product teams.
- Maintain complete technical documentation, service specifications, and system diagrams for owned services.
- Use agentic IDEs and coding assistants, such as Claude Code and Cursor, to deliver daily agent-generated code changes.
- Use AI assistance to create unit tests, test fixtures, and database migration scripts, and analyse production logs to develop root-cause hypotheses.
- Draft PR descriptions, RFCs, technical documentation, and service runbooks with AI tools, following team playbooks.
- Improve prompts, agent skills, context files, and workflows to make AI use more cost-effective.
- Review code, share effective AI prompting workflows, and mentor junior engineers.
- Coordinate across teams to meet strict deadlines and sprint planning guidelines, and support engineering colleagues in achieving system objectives.

## Requirements

- Have a minimum of 3–4 years of professional backend development experience, with a core focus on distributed microservices architectures.
- Demonstrate experience designing, building, and delivering high-volume, low-latency microservices and API endpoints.
- Be strongly proficient in Golang, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, ArangoDB, Redis, REST/GraphQL, Docker, and Weaviate for vector search/RAG.
- Have hands-on experience or deep familiarity with AI/RAG architectures, including embedding stores, vector databases, retrieval pipelines, and model evaluation datasets.
- Have experience developing comprehensive unit and integration test suites, managing test fixtures, and handling database migration strategies.
- Demonstrate adaptability to an AI-native workflow, including familiarity with Cursor or Claude Code, context engineering, prompt optimisation, and daily AI-assisted delivery.
- Have strong problem-solving and root-cause debugging skills, including log analysis, and use metrics to improve service health and latency.
- Collaborate effectively, translate technical specifications into clear designs, and represent backend architectures in discussions across teams.

## Work arrangements

- This is a full-time role in the Technology - Engineering department.
- The work location is Shikho’s HQ in Banani, Dhaka.
- The working week is 5 days, from Sunday to Thursday.

## Salary and benefits

- Salary is competitive and negotiable based on experience.
- Benefits include a festival bonus, leave encashment, and life and medical insurance.

jobs.title: Executive/Sr. Executive, Visual Design
jobs.description:
Shikho is hiring an Executive/Sr. Executive, Visual Design for its Brand Marketing team. The role combines visual concept development, motion design and animation to turn academic content and brand stories into engaging experiences across social media, the app, digital products and websites.

## Responsibilities

- Develop original concepts, graphics, layouts and style frames from briefs or eLearning storyboards.
- Translate complex academic material into clear, engaging visuals suited to students’ ages.
- Maintain visual consistency across media by following and expanding Shikho’s brand and design guidelines.
- Animate scientific concepts, custom characters, UI interactions and promotional campaign assets.
- Build original 2D/3D graphics, characters, environments, dynamic typography and asset libraries.
- Composite 2D/3D elements with live footage, CGI and tracking for brand films and app content.
- Design user screens, digital assets and marketing creatives for social media, the Shikho app and web interfaces.
- Create production-ready visual guidelines, toolkits and design systems for consistent student experiences.
- Track global EdTech and motion design trends, and propose creative and technical improvements.
- Collaborate with academic teams, copywriters, product teams, digital marketing and the wider brand team to deliver accurate, visually compelling content.
- Own the full design and animation process, from brief and concept through final rendering and export, with minimal supervision.
- Improve production efficiency by exploring software, plugins, scripts and visual shortcuts in a fast-paced environment.

## Requirements

- Have at least 3 years of professional experience at a top digital marketing agency, high-growth technology company or EdTech brand.
- Present a portfolio demonstrating strong static visual design—including layout, typography, branding and illustration—alongside advanced motion design and animation.
- Have expert proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, including After Effects, Illustrator, Photoshop, Premiere Pro and Character Animator, plus 3D software such as Cinema 4D or Blender.
- Demonstrate the ability to own projects and maintain high visual standards under tight campaign deadlines.
- Be able to pitch concepts, explain design decisions and collaborate with technical and nontechnical teams.
- Prior experience in EdTech or visual learning content design is highly preferred.

## Work arrangements

- This is a full-time position in the Brand Marketing department, based in Banani, Dhaka, Bangladesh.
- The working week is 5 days, Sunday to Thursday.

## Salary and benefits

- Salary is competitive and negotiable based on experience.
- Benefits include a festival bonus, group life and medical insurance, annual leave, leave encashment and an annual performance review.

## How to apply

- Include a portfolio link with your application. It must showcase both visual design and layout work, as well as motion graphics and animation.

jobs.title: Academic Counsellor (Jashore Tele-sales)
jobs.description:
Shikho is hiring an Academic Counsellor for its Jashore tele-sales team. The role involves helping students and parents understand Shikho’s learning products, building relationships through cold calls, and growing sales of multi-year subscriptions and multiple products.

## Responsibilities

- Counsel students and parents through structured sessions to identify their learning needs.
- Schedule appointments, conduct daily online demonstrations, and follow up with customers.
- Understand each customer’s circumstances and learning challenges, explain the effects of ineffective learning methods, and recommend suitable Shikho subscriptions.
- Handle customer objections and negotiate prices respectfully to generate sales.
- Develop an understanding of student and parent behaviour, and continually improve product knowledge and sales skills to meet and exceed growing targets.

## Requirements

- Applicants must have at least 6 months of tele-sales or call centre experience in direct-to-consumer, target-driven roles.
- Applicants must have studied the Bangla-medium National Curriculum for SSC and HSC and understand its curriculum and syllabus very well.
- Applicants must have strong communication skills in Bangla and be able to understand customer psychology and empathise with students and parents.
- Applicants must be motivated to meet and exceed sales targets, earn commissions, and develop their careers.
- Applicants must be comfortable working independently in a fast-paced environment.
- Current university students must be able to meet the required working hours.

## Work arrangements

- This is a contractual position in the Sales department at Jashore IT Park, Bangladesh.
- The schedule is 6 days a week, Saturday to Thursday, from 10:00 AM to 7:00 PM, or equivalent hours.

## Salary and benefits

- The basic salary is BDT 9k to 10.5k, with additional KPI and sales incentives for achieving sales targets.
- Casual and sick leave are available.
- Shikho offers a supportive working culture and opportunities for rapid career progression.
- Promotion may be available within 6 months, based on performance.
- There is an opportunity to move into a full-time position.

jobs.title: Android Developer (Sr. Software Engineer)
jobs.description:
Shikho is hiring an Android Developer (Sr. Software Engineer) to build and maintain mobile applications for its Bangladeshi education platform. The role focuses on reliable performance, better user experiences, and features serving hundreds of thousands of learners.

## Responsibilities

- Design scalable, high-performance Android features and translate product requirements into robust technical designs.
- Own Android architecture, modularization, build pipelines, and Play Store releases.
- Deliver assigned modules end to end on a quarterly basis, taking projects from concept to completion with strong technical quality and visual design.
- Write production-quality Kotlin with comprehensive unit and instrumented tests.
- Represent Android in cross-platform API design discussions and collaborate with the Backend team and teams working on other technology layers.
- Own app quality metrics, including startup time, rendering performance, crash-free users, and application not responding (ANR) rates.
- Use agentic IDEs and coding assistants such as Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex to support development, debugging, unit tests, edge cases, and migration scripts.
- Use AI tools to draft pull request descriptions, RFCs, and engineering documentation.
- Improve prompts, agent skills, context files, and workflows to make AI use effective and cost-efficient.
- Participate in code reviews, train junior engineers in the team’s AI workflows, and share effective prompts.
- Follow sprint planning guidelines, meet strict deadlines, and help with other technology development tasks as needed.

## Requirements

- The advert specifies “Minimum 3-6 years” of professional mobile application development experience, primarily in Android.
- Have a proven record of designing, building, and delivering high-volume, low-latency features professionally.
- Understand Android architecture, modularization strategies, build pipelines, and Play Store delivery in depth.
- Be proficient in Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Coroutines/Flow, Hilt, Retrofit, Room, Firebase, and GitHub.
- Have experience providing comprehensive unit and instrumented test coverage.
- Demonstrate adaptability to AI-native development, with familiarity using agentic IDEs such as Cursor and Claude Code, context engineering, and prompt optimization.
- Bring strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and a metrics-driven approach to monitoring crashes and ANRs.
- Collaborate effectively to turn product specifications into technical designs and represent mobile architecture in cross-platform API discussions.
- Show enthusiasm for contributing to Shikho’s education technology work.

## Work arrangements

- This is a full-time position in the Technology - Engineering department.
- The work location is Shikho’s HQ in Banani, Dhaka.
- The role reports to the Sr. Software Architect.
- The working week is 5 days, Sunday to Thursday.

## Salary and benefits

- Salary is competitive and negotiable based on experience.
- Benefits include a festival bonus, leave encashment, and life and medical insurance.

E T Consultant - Corporate Governance Advisory (EC1)

jobs.title: Specialist, Employee Relations
jobs.description:
Save the Children International is seeking a Specialist, Employee Relations for its global team. The role focuses on complex employee relations investigations, advice to senior leaders, and strengthening HR capability.

## Responsibilities

- Lead complex employee relations investigations and case resolution, managing risks and dependencies throughout the investigation lifecycle.
- Translate investigation findings and lessons into evidence-based recommendations.
- Provide expert employee relations advice to Country Office Senior Management Teams.
- Build employee relations capability within Country Office HR teams.
- Improve employee relations processes, tools and systems.

## Requirements

- Significant experience leading complex employee relations investigations, grievances and disciplinary matters.
- Expertise in providing strategic employee relations advice to senior leaders.
- Strong investigation and report-writing skills.
- The right to work in the country where the role is based.
- English proficiency is required. Arabic, French or Spanish is desirable.

## Work arrangements

- This is a full-time role with an initial 1 year fixed-term contract and potential to become permanent.
- The position may be based at any approved Save the Children International office location, including Dhaka, Bangladesh, with hybrid or remote arrangements.

## How to apply

Apply through the Save the Children International careers site by **9 November 2026**. Ensure your CV is ATS-friendly and tailored to the role.

jobs.title: Financial Consultant
jobs.description:
First4Freelancers is urgently hiring a Financial Consultant with 2–5 years of relevant experience to communicate with prospects, build client relationships, and convert leads into customers.

## Responsibilities

- Make outbound calls to potential clients, generate leads, and follow up with prospects.
- Build relationships and convert leads into customers.
- Maintain client records and track follow-ups using CRM tools.
- Support sales and marketing activities, meet targets, and contribute to business growth.

## Requirements

- Applicants must have a bachelor’s degree in Accounting.
- Candidates must have 2–5 years of experience in sales, accounting, or business development.
- Strong professional communication and persuasion skills are required, including confidence in handling calls and converting prospects.
- Candidates must be able to generate leads and follow up with potential clients.
- Basic knowledge of CRM tools and lead management is required.
- Only male candidates may apply.
- Preferred qualifications include accounting and finance knowledge, accounting or bookkeeping knowledge, lead generation experience, CRM handling skills, and customer service experience.

## Work arrangements

- Work runs Monday to Friday, from 9am to 6pm.
- The office is at Suvastu Muskan Tower, 56 Gulshan Avenue, Gulshan 1, Dhaka.
- Saturday and Sunday are the two weekly holidays. Bangladesh government holidays are not provided, except for the two Eids.

## Salary and benefits

- The monthly salary is BDT 35,000–40,000.
- Employees receive 19 days of paid leave per year.
- Salary is reviewed yearly.

## How to apply

Send your CV to career@first4freelancers.com.bd by 15 November 2026.

jobs.title: Area Sales Manager (General Trade)
jobs.description:
Emami Bangladesh Ltd. is hiring 3 Area Sales Managers (General Trade) to grow sales and distribution within assigned territories. The role involves overseeing distributors, developing sales teams and expanding market coverage.

## Responsibilities

- Achieve primary and secondary sales targets and drive distribution growth.
- Manage distributor operations, implement trade schemes and ensure pricing compliance.
- Expand market coverage and conduct regular market visits.
- Lead and develop the sales team.
- Monitor competitor activities to support sustainable business growth.

## Requirements

- Applicants must hold a bachelor’s or honours degree.
- Applicants must have 8 to 12 years of experience in FMCG manufacturing, multinational companies, or cosmetics, toiletries and personal care businesses.
- Applicants must be 35 to 40 years old.

## Work arrangements

- This is a full-time, office-based position.
- The job location may be anywhere in Bangladesh, with regular market visits required.

## Salary and benefits

- Salary is negotiable, with a yearly salary review.
- Benefits include mobile bill coverage, gratuity, insurance and travel allowance (T/A).
- Employees receive 2 festival bonuses.

## How to apply

- Apply through bdjobs.com by **19 November 2026**.
- Ensure your CV is ATS-friendly and tailored to the role.
- Applicants are encouraged to submit a video CV.

jobs.title: Channel / Market Operations Executive
jobs.description:
vivo Bangladesh is hiring 3 Channel / Market Operations Executives to manage dealer relationships and improve retail performance across assigned regions.

## Responsibilities

- Manage relationships with dealers, distributors, store owners, and store managers in the assigned region.
- Monitor sell-in, sell-out, stock levels, and sales targets. Identify underperforming stores and implement improvement plans.
- Visit markets regularly to assess store performance, understand local demand, and gather competitor information.
- Coordinate replenishment, slow-moving stock, product availability, and stock transfers with relevant teams.
- Communicate and implement approved channel policies, incentives, and promotional offers.
- Evaluate the effectiveness of store support and subsidies, and recommend improvements supported by evidence.
- Work with training, IoT, user operations, and store inspection teams to improve execution.
- Track issues through resolution, assigning clear owners and deadlines and documenting completion.

## Requirements

- Applicants must hold a bachelor’s or honours degree.
- Applicants must have 1 to 2 years of experience in the mobile industry, including hands-on channel sales or market operations experience with a mobile phone brand, consumer electronics brand, distributor, or established electronics retail chain.
- Applicants must be male and aged 28 to 32 years.
- Candidates must have direct experience managing dealers or retail outlets and making regular field visits.
- Candidates must understand distributor–dealer–retailer relationships, channel margins, incentives, inventory, and sell-in versus sell-out.
- Candidates must be able to diagnose store performance issues and recommend practical actions.
- Strong relationship management and negotiation skills are required, including the ability to enforce agreed standards.
- Candidates must have working Excel skills for tracking sales, stock, and targets.
- Strong Bangla communication skills and sufficient English for reporting and internal coordination are required.
- Candidates must be willing to travel regularly within their assigned region.

## Work arrangements

- This is a full-time, office-based role in Tejgaon Industrial Area, Dhaka.
- Regular market visits and travel within the assigned region are required.

## Salary and benefits

- The monthly salary is Tk. 45000.

## How to apply

- Apply through the vivo Bangladesh circular on bdjobs.com by 4 November 2026.
- Ensure your CV is ATS-friendly and tailored to this role.

jobs.title: DevOps Administrator
jobs.description:
Therap (BD) Ltd. is hiring a DevOps Administrator with 1–3 years of experience for a hands-on role supporting and improving production environments. The work focuses on Linux administration, Java application troubleshooting, and practical SRE approaches to reliability and performance.

## Responsibilities

- Manage Linux systems, including daily administration, troubleshooting, performance tuning, and basic security hardening.
- Support Java-based applications and their web and application servers.
- Maintain and improve CI/CD build and deployment pipelines, automating repetitive tasks where possible.
- Investigate deployment failures, performance problems, and unexpected system behavior using logs and metrics to identify root causes.
- Write and maintain scripts, primarily in Bash, with Python where appropriate.
- Participate in production releases and handle off-hours issues when required, with support duties shared across the team.

## Requirements

- A B.Sc. in CSE, EEE, or a related technical field is required.
- Candidates must have 1–3 years of experience in DevOps, system administration, or a similar role.
- Strong Linux fundamentals and confidence using the command line are required.
- Candidates need practical troubleshooting and analytical skills.
- A basic understanding of JVM-based applications is required, including memory usage, logs, and common failure patterns.
- Candidates should be willing to learn, take ownership, and persist through technical problems.

Preferred qualifications:

- Exposure to Docker, Kubernetes, or similar container technologies is desirable; home lab experience counts.
- Experience with monitoring or observability tools such as Prometheus or Grafana is preferred.
- Experience supporting production systems and familiarity with modern DevOps practices are desirable.

## Work arrangements

- Off-hours production support may be required, with responsibilities shared across the team.

## Salary and benefits

- The role offers experience with live production systems, a supportive team, and opportunities to develop further in DevOps engineering.
